title: Continuous Gaussian Process Pre-Optimization for Asynchronous Event-Inertial Odometry
core_idea: Introduce GPO, a continuous-time preintegration framework that models inertial integration as two local temporal Gaussian process trajectories and uses a lightweight two-step optimization to infer continuous preintegration pseudo-measurements and propagate Jacobians for arbitrary queried states, enabling tightly-coupled asynchronous fusion of event cameras and IMUs with linear and constant-time costs for optimization and query.
tldr: GPO models inertial preintegration with temporal Gaussian processes to enable efficient, continuous-time tightly-coupled asynchronous fusion of event cameras and IMUs.
